note: The model reads stack size but not which object is on top.
A false intervening-if leaves an effect half with no events (gate); the win itself is a player_removed event for the loser.
A fizzled spell writes no effect half, so the outcome is only an input.
The regeneration shield on the permanent is not in the snapshot.
The cast-without-priority ordering is not an output; the library order that decides it is hidden.
The last known power is read from the snapshot taken before the exile.
Only counts of creatures died, spells cast and lands played are read, not that a creature attacked.
The permanent's current types and last power are in the snapshot.
Judged from the rule text; the scenario is skipped.
Where the stack object goes depends on flashback, and the cast origin is not read.
Chapter lore counters are read; the saga trigger on a non-acting permanent is not.
The countered case is trained on Counterspell's record; build-corpus refuses a permanent spell's resolution record for acting through no text (FR-148).
An illegal-target permanent spell fizzles and writes no effect half; the bestowed case resolves in a permanent-spell record build-corpus refuses.
The attach belongs to the Aura spell's own resolution, which build-corpus refuses.
Merging with the target is recorded as no event of its own.
Clone's move to the graveyard belongs to its own permanent-spell resolution, which build-corpus refuses.
The copy's resolution into a token is a refused permanent-spell record; only the copy event of Lithoform Engine's resolution remains.
The dash cost paid and the static ability it enables are not read.
